items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest aggravated at practice); misses minimum 4 weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated; official IR move.
items.implication: Extended absence; role already eroding pre-injury.
items.opportunity: Backfield opens further for remaining RBs/handcuffs.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip issue; expected to return vs Eagles. Speculation on possible snap limits.
items.why: Cleared final injury report; Schefter notes expected to play.
items.implication: WR1 return boosts Rams pass game; monitor for limited snaps impacting volume.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets if unrestricted; could cap Davante Adams share.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN and good to go (hamstring) vs Cowboys.
items.why: Final report clear; Texans PR and Rapoport confirm good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return in high-scoring implied environment.
items.opportunity: Full target share expected; Cowboys DvP inflates opposing WR by 7.3%.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins.
items.why: Ruled out on final reports; Schefter list confirms.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Vikings offense home vs weak secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Eagles also without Goedert and Baun.
items.why: Ruled out; Schefter and beat confirm hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles pass catchers thinned significantly; offense worse.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs/TEs like Wicks.

items.implication: Jets RB snaps fully available to backups.

items.text: Jordan Addison gets the moment truthers waited for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson absence + favorable matchup opens full opportunity.
items.implication: Must-start WR2/flex with inflated target share and big-play upside.
items.opportunity: Primary receiver role; high route/target share expected.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + game environment + return health.
items.implication: Strong WR1 play with smash spot upside.
items.opportunity: High target volume in positive script potential.

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT; Eagles missing three key pieces (Smith/Goedert/Baun) vs Rams.
items.implication: TE vacuum and overall Eagles skill degradation.
items.opportunity: Possible TE streamer or WR target bump in Philly.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL tear confirmed earlier; listed OUT).
items.why: Torn ACL in Week 3; IR; season over.
items.implication: MIA RB committee or lead changes permanently for 2026.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity to Wright/Gordon etc.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (left elbow) again vs Colts in London.
items.why: Continues recovery; ruled out on reports.
items.implication: WAS QB streaming or backup start; offense capped.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back. Passes eye test longer-term but role eroded.
items.why: Multiple role losses + injury + competition returning.
items.implication: Near-term fantasy irrelevant; monitor post-IR for rebound.
items.opportunity: Pre-injury snap/carry share already declining; GL/pass eroded.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse role locked with Dowdle absent; strong matchup.
items.implication: RB1/high-end RB2 start with volume floor.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap/touch share; third-down and GL likely.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Poor usage trends + tough run defense matchup.
items.implication: Sit/fade; low floor in limited role.
